data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-t-n, meaning 'to give', 'to send', or 'to give a gift'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hutun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
